verdict.rationale: Publishing exact statutory filing fees is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains only HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and no page content was fetched. There is no evidence either way on whether fee amounts are published, which defaults to none, with low confidence because the gap comes from an access wall rather than an observed absence.
